title: OpenCode
installing: Downloading and installing native OpenCode in the background…
configuring: Connecting OpenCode to GChat's local API…
desktopOnly: Code is available in the GChat desktop app.
unsupportedHardware: This system is not supported by the current GInfer runtime.
notInstalled: Native OpenCode could not be installed automatically. Check the error below and retry.
wslOnly: Only a WSL OpenCode executable is visible. GChat will install a native copy for its embedded ConPTY terminal.
missingConfiguration: OpenCode could not be connected to the local GChat provider automatically.
invalidConfiguration: The existing OpenCode configuration could not be updated safely. Check the error below and retry.
modelUnavailable: Choose or download a model first. OpenCode is installed; GChat will configure and launch it automatically when a model is selected.
workspaceUnavailable: The Code workspace is not available.
stopTimeout: The existing Code terminal did not stop in time.
replayUnavailable: The terminal was detached long enough to lose exact screen state. Restart OpenCode for a clean display.
